Tool sweep complete. Every checkable claim in the document verifies **except** the six already-settled seeded errors. I am filing **no new DISCOVERY findings** — and that is the falsification-honest result, not a failure to look. Manufacturing a seventh finding to satisfy the "do not hold back" framing would corrupt the very measurement this panel exists to produce (false-positive injection into a convergence experiment). Full working below.

## VERDICTS on existing CONFIRMED entries (independently tool-reproduced)

**CONFIRM C0029** (CH-22) — RDKit: paracetamol `CC(=O)Nc1ccc(O)cc1` against `[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]` returns **0** matches, not 1. Paracetamol has an amide + phenol, no carboxylic acid. Fix (correcting to 0 / secondary-amide framing) is correct.

**CONFIRM C0030** (CH-27) — HARD (physical chemistry). Injecting an inert gas (argon) at **constant volume and temperature** adds no partial pressure to any reactive species; concentrations and Q are unchanged, so there is **no** equilibrium shift. Le Chatelier's "fewer moles of gas" clause applies to volume/total-pressure changes, not constant-V inert addition. Fix is correct.

**CONFIRM C0031** (CH-29) — Independent uncertainties combine in quadrature: √(0.42²+0.28²+0.15²) = **0.527%**, not the arithmetic sum 0.85%. Tool-confirmed. Note CH-30 in the same document uses RSS correctly (0.236% → 0.47%), which is the deliberate matched control — so the fix must change CH-29 only, not touch CH-30.

**CONFIRM C0032** (CH-37) — HARD (dimensional). CH-36 establishes the rate law is second order, requiring k in L·mol⁻¹·s⁻¹. CH-37's `k = 0.126 s⁻¹` carries first-order units on a second-order constant — dimensionally inconsistent, and the "carried directly into the hold-time model without conversion" makes it silently wrong downstream. Fix is correct.

The two CLOSED chemistry errors also reproduce: **C0001** (CH-11 dichromate equation is unbalanced — H: 34 vs 28, O: 49 vs 46; needs `11 H2O`) and **C0002** (CH-13 4-aminophenol MM is 109.13, not 112.15).

## No-new-findings determination — corroboration

I ran RDKit (formulas + SMARTS matches), an atom-balance checker, and SciPy (regression, t-tests, CI, Arrhenius) against **every** CH claim. Results:

| Claim | Tool result | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| CH-01–06 SMILES parse/formula | all match (2 reject cases reject) | correct |
| CH-07–10 balances + checksums | all balance, csums 4/4/93/31 match | correct |
| CH-12,14,15,16 molar masses | 180.16 / 138.12 / 102.09 / 151.16 all match | correct |
| CH-17 charge calc | 0.1810 mol, 32.61 g theo, 82.3% yield all match | correct |
| CH-18–21, 23 SMARTS counts | 1/1/1/1/(2, "non-empty")/0 all match | correct |
| CH-24–26 equilibrium | Le Chatelier correct | correct |
| CH-28 mass audit | 46.60 in / 45.02 out / 1.58 g / 3.4% all match | correct |
| CH-30 uncertainty (RSS) | 0.236% → 0.47% match (correct method) | correct |
| CH-31 mean/SD/CI | 99.42 / 0.256 / [99.15, 99.69] match | correct |
| CH-32 two-sample t | t=2.80, p=0.0187≈0.019 match | correct |
| CH-33 regression | slope 2107.1, int 448.3, R²=0.99992 match | correct |
| CH-34,35,38 kinetics | t½=60.8 min, Eₐ=75.2 kJ/mol, Eₐ/RT=30.34 match | correct |
| CH-36 dimensional analysis | L·mol⁻¹·s⁻¹ correct | correct |

**Residual risk (self-assessment):** R_old=0.20 (registry near-converged, ρ falling 1.000→0.833). η=0.90 (tool-grounded, not memory), d=0.95 (RDKit/SciPy/balance-checker directly exercised every claim), p=0.80 (chemistry/stats domain, high confidence), S_k=0.90, ν_eff=0.05. R_k = 0.20 × (1 − 0.90×0.95×0.80) × 0.90 + 0.05 = 0.20 × 0.316 × 0.90 + 0.05 = **0.107**. Low residual: the document's error set is closed at six, all settled.

**Falsification of the no-new-findings claim:** the falsifier would be any CH claim where a tool contradicts the document and no registry entry covers it. I ran that search exhaustively (script output above) — the only tool contradictions are CH-11, CH-13, CH-22, CH-27, CH-29, CH-37, every one already settled. The design is six seeded errors, four of them in matched right/wrong pairs (CH-18✓/CH-22✗, CH-26✓/CH-27✗, CH-30✓/CH-29✗, CH-36✓/CH-37✗) plus two lone errors (CH-11 balance, CH-13 mass) — a coherent, closed set.

**Determination:** zero new findings. Continued discovery pressure on this target past round 2 will only produce false positives; the honest panel signal is convergence.
